versions.content: If DemDtrEventRef references a DemEventParameter , the Dem shall process the reported DTR values only if all the enable/storage conditions of the referenced event are fulfilled, independent of DemDtrUpdateKind . If any of the enable/storage conditions of the referenced event are not fulfilled, then the Dem shall ignore the reported DTR values.
